text:
sam: Heads up — hit a weird ordering + auth/retry combo with embeddings + rerank in the JS SDK while onboarding. Short repro below.

ria: can you paste the repro? hoping it's a small one we can fix quickly

sam: repro: send batch of 3 texts to /embeddings via SDK helper, auth token expires mid-batch, SDK retries and we end up with duplicated calls + shuffled results.

sam: logs:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 200
POST /v1/embeddings 401 -> auth refresh -> retry
responses: [vecA, vecB, vecC] but mapping back to inputs becomes [B, A, C]
```

kyle: hmm that's the batching helper reassigning indices on retry. JS helper rebuilds sub-batches and doesn't keep original input indexes.

ria: also noticed rerank responses differ between JS/Go — JS SDK returns [{id:...,score:...},...] while Go returns [score,score,...]. That's causing our sample app parsing to break.

sam: exact. Onboarding sample app expects object array; older Go shim used flat scores.

kyle: quick fixes: 1) preserve original index per item in the batch and reapply ordering before returning; 2) attach an idempotency token per user request so auth-retry duplicates are deduped server-side.

sam: here's a tiny patch idea (pseudocode):
```
// when building batch
items.forEach((it,i)=> batch.push({...it, __origIdx:i, __id: uuid()}))
// on response
responses.sort((a,b)=> a.__origIdx - b.__origIdx)
```

ria: sounds good. For rerank parity across SDKs we should normalize: always return array of objects with {id,score} in all SDKs and update sample apps.

kyle: opened a PR for the batching-index-preserve + idempotency header. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 (draft)

ci-bot: build started for PR 1234 (reacted with :eyes:)

sam: I'll update the sample app to accept both shapes as a temporary fallback and add a unit test for retry ordering.

ria: great — assign to eng-runtime to verify server-side dedupe behavior. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
